metadata.question: Did the volcanic plume from Mount Lewotobi Laki-Laki on the Indonesian island of Flores drift westward at about 2 pm local time on July 7, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Mount Lewotobi Laki-Laki, Flores, Indonesia (approximately 8.5°S, 122.8°E) - Date: July 7, 2025, around 2 PM local time (Indonesia Central Time = UTC+8, so ~06:00 UTC) - Collection: Sentinel-2 or other optical sensors to detect volcanic plume (ash/SO2) - Note: This is a future date (as of my knowledge cutoff), but I'll proceed with the analysis assuming the code will run when data is available 2. Masking strategy: - DO NOT mask clouds - we're looking FOR the volcanic plume which appears as cloud-like feature - Look for aerosol/ash signatures or use visual bands to detect plume direction 3. Logic: - Need to detect plume presence and direction - Compare images before/during eruption if possible - Westward drift means higher aerosol/plume signal to the west of the volcano - Valid detection = A (westward) or B (not westward) - No data = C1, No valid pixels = C2, Calculation failure = C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const volcano = ee.Geometry.Point([122.775, -8.532]); // Mount Lewotobi Laki-Laki const westRegion = ee.Geometry.Point([122.675, -8.532]).buffer(5000); // 5km west const eastRegion = ee.Geometry.Point([122.875, -8.532]).buffer(5000); // 5km east // July 7, 2025, 2 PM local time (UTC+8) = 06:00 UTC const targetDate = '2025-07-07'; const startDate = '2025-07-06'; const endDate = '2025-07-08'; // 2. Data Acquisition let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(volcano) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .sort('system:time_start'); const colSize = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try Landsat 8/9 col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(volcano) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const landsatSize = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat images found: ${landsatSize}`); if (landsatSize === 0) { console.log('No imagery available for the specified date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Get the closest image to target time const img = ee.Image(col.first()); const imgDate = new Date(img.get('system:time_start').getInfo()); console.log(`Using image from: ${imgDate.toISOString()}`); // 3. Aerosol/Plume Detection (using Aerosol band or RGB composite) let aerosol; if (img.bandNames().contains('B1').getInfo()) { // Sentinel-2: Use aerosol band (B1) or create aerosol index aerosol = img.select('B1'); // Coastal aerosol band } else { // Landsat: Use SR_QA_AEROSOL or blue band as proxy aerosol = img.select('SR_B2'); // Blue band } // 4. Calculate aerosol signal in west vs east regions const westStats = aerosol.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: westRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const eastStats = aerosol.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: eastRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const westMean = westStats.B1_mean || westStats.SR_B2_mean; const westCount = westStats.B1_count || westStats.SR_B2_count; const eastMean = eastStats.B1_mean || eastStats.SR_B2_mean; const eastCount = eastStats.B1_count || eastStats.SR_B2_count; console.log(`West region - Mean: ${westMean}, Pixels: ${westCount}`); console.log(`East region - Mean: ${eastMean}, Pixels: ${eastCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (westCount === 0 || eastCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in comparison regions.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (westMean == null || eastMean == null || isNaN(westMean) || isNaN(eastMean)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Westward plume means higher aerosol signal to the west const ratio = westMean / eastMean; console.log(`West/East aerosol ratio: ${ratio.toFixed(2)}`); if (ratio > 1.15) { console.log('Volcanic plume detected drifting westward.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No significant westward plume drift detected.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
